purpose: National 100 m HICAR domain with every Swiss grid cell outside the lateral boundary zone.
crs: local azimuthal equidistant centred on 46.815 N, 8.225 E (WGS84)

static_sources.interior: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, ESA WorldCover 2021, SoilGrids

required_gates: Validate the rectangle contains the Swiss bounding box with at least 50 km projected margin.
Retain at least 20 km between the Swiss bounding box and the end of the 30 km topography-transition zone.
Validate ICON HSURF covers the full HICAR domain before blending.
Validate the final static file and create its .ready marker only after validation.
Validate the derived forcing grid against the selected ICON grid.
Run capacity and physical-quality tests before a national production simulation.
